instruction: Disable the background cone (VLC logo) in VLC's interface so that the player window shows a plain background when no media is loaded.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VLC Advanced Preferences > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt, found the volume slider color setting, changed it to black (0;0;0), and saved preferences.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC Tools menu, navigate to Advanced Preferences, expand Interface tree to Qt settings, modify checkboxes and input fields, and save preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: The agent demonstrated ability to navigate VLC Qt preferences. This variation tests a different Qt setting (background cone toggle) visible on the same preferences page.
metadata.explanation: Task requires unchecking the 'Display background cone or art' option in VLC's Qt interface preferences. Evaluator reads vlcrc config and checks if qt-bgcone equals 0 (disabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) from the VM, which contains the qt-bgcone setting.
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses vlcrc, searches for 'qt-bgcone=' line, and compares the value against expected '0' (disabled). Default value '1' (enabled) is correctly set.
Expected value '0' correctly represents the disabled state of the background cone, matching the instruction requirement.
Parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', the framework passes {'expected_qt_bgcone': '0'} as the rule parameter, and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly.
Postconfig kills VLC and relaunches it, ensuring the config file is written to disk before the getter reads it.
Single instruction requirement (disable background cone) is fully covered by the evaluator.
